item.title: Confessional 1.31.1
item.description:
• Ask about this meeting: a question box under the summary and transcript.
  • Copy button for the summary.
  • One click to accept a speaker's suggested name.
  • Tidier meeting list (time only under Today/Yesterday).

item.title: Confessional 1.31.0
item.description:
• Screenshots of the whole screen or a video window are trimmed afterwards to the part that kept changing (the video or shared screen); originals kept, snapped ones untouched, meeting-window captures untouched.
  • New projects are offered ('Start a … project?') instead of being created automatically; meetings still go into a project that clearly fits.

item.title: Confessional 1.30.3
item.description:
• When you watch this Mac over Screen Sharing, the floating call controls (and live captions) now show there automatically; they stay out of screen shares on calls otherwise.
  • recording.json notes the Confessional version.

item.title: Confessional 1.30.2
item.description: • New: Settings → Recording → 'Show the call controls over Screen Sharing', for watching this Mac from another one (off by default, so the controls stay out of screen shares on calls).

item.title: Confessional 1.30.1
item.description:
• Live captions in the menu bar menu too, for when the floating call bar is hidden or on another display.
  • The call bar comes back on screen if it was left off every display.
  • recording.json now notes where the call bar appeared and how many caption lines were made.

item.title: Confessional 1.30.0
item.description:
• The menu bar menu shows what's next today and what's still open from your last meeting (tick items off right there); while recording it spells out whether audio, screenshots and captions work.
  • Try a test recording at the end of setup or in Settings → Recording: your voice transcribed, a screenshot and a test tone, nothing saved.
  • Fixed: the 'Related in other meetings' and 'Settled in recent meetings?' panels could fail to load.

item.title: Confessional 1.29.0
item.description:
• Capture lights in the call bar: audio, screenshots and captions, green when working and orange (with the reason) when not
  • ⌘K command bar: jump to any meeting or project, ask a question, start recording, open any setting
  • Chapters above long transcripts; fix a split speaker with “Same person as…” (with Undo)
  • Easier to read in dark mode

item.title: Confessional 1.28.0
item.description:
• Screenshots when there's no call window: the call bar says so and one click captures the video's window (YouTube, a player…) or the whole screen
  • Live captions start on their own once the speech model has downloaded on a new Mac
  • Studio finds laughs in shows with a studio audience

item.title: Confessional 1.27.0
item.description:
• Your confessional stays yours: by default only a model on this Mac reads it (Settings → Privacy), and it's offered only after real calls
  • Home starts with what needs you: your own open action items, ticked off right there
  • As simple or as deep as you like: basic settings by default for new users, “Show all settings” for everything, and choose what's in the sidebar
  • Clearer record bar, Highlights gallery, a topics chart from the first week, and an example in empty chats

item.title: Confessional 1.26.0
item.description:
• Records on Macs without a microphone (Mac Studio, Mac mini): Start Recording now records the call audio and screenshots instead of hanging and crashing; plug in a mic during the call and it's added
  • Use Hermes, Pi or another agent harness (Settings → AI Models → Agent harness): chats stay one conversation in the agent, which compacts long ones itself, and it can look things up in your meetings with Confessional's tools
